title: Towards Alignment-Centric Paradigm: A Survey of Instruction Tuning in Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 2025 年指令微调与对齐综述预印本
best_for_zh: 关于专家示范、教师蒸馏与自我改进数据的指令微调综述。
one_line: This survey organizes instruction tuning around data origin, tuning strategy, and evaluation rather than treating all prompts and answers as one data type.
该综述从数据来源、调优策略和评测协议梳理大语言模型指令微调的对齐逻辑。
why: It makes the provenance difference between expert demonstrations, teacher distillation, and self-improvement explicit at the atlas entry point.
inclusion_reason: A contemporary alignment-oriented map of instruction-data lineages that routes readers from Track0 into demonstrations, distillation, self-improvement, and evaluation evidence.

title: Problem
问题
html: Instruction tuning is used to align LLMs with human intentions, safety constraints, and domain requirements, but the data lineage is often compressed into a generic prompt–response table. The primary source is the arXiv preprint at https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.17184, submitted in 2025 and revised on arXiv in November 2025. Its focus is instruction-data taxonomy: it maps a full instruction-tuning pipeline and routes readers to concrete demonstrations, distillation, self-improvement, and evaluation work rather than introducing one new dataset. The relevant data object is an instruction, a response whose origin must be known, and the data-construction, tuning, and evaluation context around that pair. Individual release claims still need their original source.
指令微调用于使 LLM 与人类意图、安全约束和领域需求对齐，但训练数据的来源脉络常被简化成普通的提示词与回答表。该论文是 arXiv 预印本，2025 年 8 月提交，11 月修订。它梳理了完整的指令微调流程，包括示范数据、蒸馏、自我改进和评测，而不是发布新数据集。论文关注的记录是一条指令、具有明确来源的回答，以及围绕这一指令回答对的数据构建、调优和评测背景。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey presents instruction tuning as a full pipeline of data collection, fine-tuning strategy, and evaluation. Its key taxonomy divides data construction into expert annotation, distillation from larger models, and self-improvement mechanisms, emphasizing their different quality, scalability, and resource-cost trade-offs. The feedback contract is not one shared verifier: quality and alignment signals depend on the primary work under discussion. The direction label is alignment-centric instruction tuning. Compare the three construction lineages with their concrete data releases, and keep them distinct from preference pairs, process labels, or programmatically verified outcomes.
综述将指令微调视为由数据收集、调优策略和评测组成的完整流程。其核心分类框架把数据构建分为专家标注、从更大模型蒸馏和自我改进三类，并讨论它们在质量、可扩展性和资源成本上的不同取舍。论文没有提出统一的验证器；质量和对齐信号取决于各项被综述工作。三类来源也不同于偏好对、过程标签和程序验证结果。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a survey rather than an implementation or a new data release. It synthesizes data collection methodologies, full-parameter and parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies, and evaluation protocols. Within its data taxonomy, an instruction-response example may come from expert annotation, a larger-model distillation process, or self-improvement; the paper frames those sources as trade-offs rather than equivalent labels. The output is a pipeline map. Use it to classify instruction data and evaluation evidence, not as a recipe for SFT, distillation, or safety alignment. To reproduce a referenced approach, inspect the source dataset's collection protocol, response generator, filtering, split, license, and evaluation setup; the survey itself does not supply those release-level fields.
这是一篇综述，不是实现论文或新数据发布。它综合讨论数据收集方法、全参数和参数高效调优策略，以及评测协议。在其分类框架中，指令回答样本可以来自专家标注、更大模型蒸馏或自我改进；这些来源代表不同取舍，而不是同一种标签。论文给出的是流程图，而非监督微调、蒸馏或安全对齐的具体配方。被综述方法的数据收集协议、回答生成器、过滤、划分、许可证和评测设置属于各自的原始发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official arXiv abstract states that the survey covers data collection, full-parameter and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and evaluation protocols. It explicitly identifies expert annotation, larger-model distillation, and self-improvement as three data-construction paradigms, and discusses evaluation of faithfulness, utility, and safety in multilingual and multimodal settings. This evidence supports the taxonomy, not the effectiveness or provenance of every paper it surveys.
arXiv 官方摘要称，该综述覆盖数据收集、全参数与参数高效调优和评测协议；并明确列出专家标注、更大模型蒸馏和自我改进三种数据构建范式。论文还讨论多语言、多模态环境中的忠实性、实用性和安全性评测。这些内容支持其分类框架，但不证明被综述的每个数据集都有效或来源明确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Instruction-tuning discussions often focus on optimization while leaving the origin of the response data implicit. This survey makes data origin a first-class alignment distinction and connects it to tuning and evaluation choices. Its direction signal is that expert demonstrations, teacher distillation, and self-improvement should not be given the same audit assumptions. It does not introduce instruction tuning, LoRA, or synthetic data. Before reuse, inspect each primary release for source provenance, filtering, safety claims, language coverage, licensing, and benchmark contamination controls.
指令微调的讨论常聚焦优化方式，却较少说明回答数据来自哪里。本文将数据来源作为对齐中的核心区分，并把来源与调优和评测选择联系起来。专家示范、教师蒸馏和自我改进具有不同的数据属性。论文没有首创指令微调、低秩适配（LoRA）或合成数据；数据来源、过滤、安全主张、语言覆盖、许可证和基准污染控制则由各项原始发布说明。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The work is an arXiv preprint; this card does not claim a conference or journal acceptance. A taxonomy cannot confirm the quality, license, or safety properties of individual instruction datasets. The survey's broad scope across text, multilingual, and multimodal settings also means that a category label alone is insufficient evidence that a concrete construction process transfers across domains.
该工作是 arXiv 预印本，未在此记录中确认会议或期刊发表状态。分类框架不能确认单个指令数据集的质量、许可证或安全性质。综述还跨越文本、多语言和多模态设置，因此仅有类别标签不足以证明某个具体构建过程可跨领域迁移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey classifies instruction-tuning data by provenance, including expert-authored examples, larger-model outputs used for distillation, and self-improvement traces. It relates those sources to different tuning methods and evaluation protocols. The paper does not treat instruction-response formatting alone as evidence of alignment quality.
综述按来源对指令微调数据分类，包括专家撰写的样本、用于蒸馏的更大模型输出，以及自我改进轨迹。它将这些来源与不同的调优方法和评测协议联系起来。论文不把指令回答的格式本身视为对齐质量的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The essential distinction is provenance, not just text shape. Two identical-looking instruction-response pairs can have different audit obligations if one came from experts, one from a teacher model, and one from a self-improvement loop. Keep the collection mechanism, tuning method, and evaluation protocol together when routing an entry.
指令回答的价值不仅由文本内容决定，也取决于它来自专家、教师模型还是自我改进循环。不同来源会带来不同的能力、偏差与对齐方式；这篇综述将数据来源、调优策略和评测协议放在同一幅图中理解。
